name: Shots on the panorama (task #4, after the gate's GO)
registered: 2026-10-20, after the gate's GO and before any shot clip is processed or any M1 shot output exists

gate.consequence: expected recall is capped at the reachable share in every report: 0.73 overall, 0.30 on a camera like M7's

rule: the events.py shot rule (ball speed, ray on the goal mouth, distance to goal) on the pipeline's pitch tracks (v3, static points dropped, linked: tune_rules ball 'v3s_link'), plus a filter keeping only shots toward the goal the possessor's team attacks (team mean x over the clip's half from the clip's own players).
dev data: the 26 gate attempts (M7 1st, M9 2nd) as clips -15 s / +10 s, merged where they overlap, plus the 8 processed non-M1 windows not in a test half (their attempts and their minutes as negatives)
dev choice: the cell maximising F1 at 2 s (one to one, SHOT and GOAL labels), pooled over dev; ties: fewer events, then the higher SHOT_MIN_KMH
test data: M1 (117092): clips -15 s / +10 s around all 29 BAS SHOT/GOAL of both halves, merged; negatives: the 4 processed M1 windows (12 min, 0 attempts). Camera: the M1 refit (a warp fitted to player feet; not validated for the ball; disclosed)
primary: recall at 2 s, one to one against SHOT and GOAL, on the 29 M1 attempts, with a Wilson interval
secondary: false shots per minute on the 4 M1 windows, and the predicted half precision R*n / (R*n + F*T_final_third), T_final_third from the BAS actor positions' share in the final thirds
xG (models/xg_xghub.json) of the matched shots at the possessor's feet, against the GSR shooter's
success: recall >= 16/29 AND predicted half precision >= 0.5 AND team right on >= 80% of matched shots
order: dev processing starts once the goals test is scored; the M1 clips are processed only after the dev choice is frozen in frozen_shots.json (hashed)
power: 29 attempts: recall known to about +-0.17 at best
